description: Curated native tachyon-core Desync packet optimization strategy presets (Adaptive 2.0 and tuned profiles).

desync.name: Adaptive 2.0 Autopilot (16 recipes + cache.db)
desync.description: Built-in tachyon-core Adaptive 2.0 autopilot with RST origin forensics, AutoTTL calibration, hedged probing, and UDP ladder.

desync.name: Fake + Split (midsld, TCP MD5, UDP Fake)
desync.description: Default tachyon-core desync preset combining decoy ClientHello, mid-SLD TCP segmentation, and UDP QUIC/STUN fake packets.

desync.name: Fake + Disorder (Out-of-order MidSLD)
desync.description: Decoy ClientHello combined with out-of-order TCP segment delivery.

desync.name: Multi-Disorder (TLSRec + Fake + Multi-cut)
desync.description: TLS record pre-split, decoy ClientHello, and reverse multi-segment disorder.

desync.name: Multi-Split (TLSRec + SNI + MidSLD)
desync.description: Multi-point TCP segmentation at TLS record, SNI, and mid-SLD boundaries without fake packets.

desync.name: TLS Record Split (pos=sni)
desync.description: RFC-compliant outer TLS Record splitting at the SNI extension boundary.

desync.name: Out-of-order Disorder (pos=midsld)
desync.description: Out-of-order TCP segment delivery across the second-level domain boundary.

desync.name: Mid-SLD TCP Split
desync.description: Clean TCP segment split at the middle of the second-level domain.

desync.name: Low-TTL Fake Only (TTL=6, UDP Fake)
desync.description: Decoy ClientHello and UDP QUIC/STUN fake packet injection without TCP segmentation.

desync.name: TCP Out-Of-Band URG (pos=1)
desync.description: TCP MSG_OOB urgent byte injection with 1-byte ClientHello segmentation.

desync.name: HostFakeSplit + Disorder (sni,endhost-1, md5_badack, seqovl=4)
desync.args: mode=fake_disorder split_pos=sni,endhost-1 fooling=md5_badack fake_sni=rzd.ru seqovl=4 repeats=2
desync.description: In-band exact-length hostname replacement with valid-checksum TCP MD5 and BadAck fooling.

desync.name: 7-Point Multi-Disorder (md5_badack, rndsni, tlsrec_first)
desync.description: Seven-point reverse disorder with TLS record pre-split and randomized same-length SNI.

desync.name: Fake + Disorder (midsld+2, badack, padencap, seqovl=8)
desync.args: mode=fake_disorder split_pos=midsld+2 fooling=badack fake_sni=padencap tlsrec_first=true seqovl=8 repeats=2
desync.description: Exact-length TLS padding encapsulation with BadAck fooling and 8-byte sequence overlap.

desync.name: Fake + Split (sniext+1, datanoack, gosuslugi.ru, seqovl=12)
desync.args: mode=fake_split split_pos=sniext+1 fooling=datanoack fake_sni=gosuslugi.ru tlsrec_first=true seqovl=12 repeats=2
desync.description: Clears TCP ACK flag on decoy segments with 12-byte sequence overlap.

desync.name: 7-Point Multi-Disorder (badseq_badack_badsum, ozon.ru)
desync.args: mode=multi_disorder split_pos=1,sniext+1,host+1,midsld-2,midsld,midsld+2,endhost-1 fooling=badseq_badack_badsum fake_sni=ozon.ru tlsrec_first=true seqovl=4 repeats=2
desync.description: Compound BadSeq + BadAck + BadSum 7-point reverse disorder for strict stateful middleboxes.

desync.name: HostFakeSplit + AutoTTL (sni,endhost-1, autottl, max.ru)
desync.args: mode=fake_disorder split_pos=sni,endhost-1 fooling=autottl fake_sni=max.ru tlsrec_first=true repeats=2
desync.description: Calibrated hop-distance AutoTTL decoy injection with in-band HostFakeSplit.

desync.name: Fake + Split (midsld, TTL=4, max.ru, repeats=6)
desync.description: Low-TTL decoy ClientHello burst followed by mid-SLD TCP split.

desync.name: Fake + Split (midsld, TTL=6, www.google.com, repeats=6)
desync.description: TTL=6 Google decoy ClientHello burst followed by mid-SLD TCP split.

desync.name: Fake + Split (sni, TTL=5, gosuslugi.ru, repeats=6)

desync.name: Fake + Split (pos=1, TTL=4, sberbank.ru, repeats=6)

desync.name: Fake + Split (pos=2, TTL=8, max.ru, repeats=8)

desync.name: TLS Record Split (pos=2, delay=1ms)
desync.description: Two-byte TLS record split for stateless packet parsers.

desync.name: TTL=1 Disorder (pos=midsld)

desync.name: CS2 / Faceit / Cybershoke: TCP Fake+Split + UDP Fake (8x, TTL=6, udplen=128)
